standard_prerequisites.name: A pseudo-coherent complex on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme is a homotopy colimit of perfect complexes with isomorphisms on the truncations above a moving bound

standard_prerequisites.name: The dual of a perfect complex is perfect, and tensoring an S-perfect complex with a perfect complex stays S-perfect

standard_prerequisites.name: For a proper flat morphism of finite presentation the pushforward of an S-perfect complex is perfect and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change

standard_prerequisites.name: Tor amplitude is independent of the base change, and a perfect complex whose fibre over a point has cohomology concentrated in high degrees has tor amplitude bounded below by that degree
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the two sided tor amplitude bound for the cones C_n, hence the bound for their duals.

standard_prerequisites.name: The homotopy colimit of a system of perfect complexes with isomorphisms on truncations below a moving bound is pseudo-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the homotopy colimit of the duals L_n with the required pseudo-coherent complex L.

core_obligations: Note that X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated because S is, and write K as a homotopy colimit of perfect complexes K_n in such a way that the maps induce isomorphisms on the truncations above minus n (proof lines 9251-9254).

Take the duals K_n dual, which are perfect, and observe that their tensor products with E are S-perfect, so the relative perfection statement applies and produces an inverse system of perfect complexes M_n on S with the displayed identification with the derived pushforward of the sheaf Hom, together with its base change compatibility (proof lines 9254-9264).

Use the truncation isomorphism to see that the comparison maps of the duals are isomorphisms below n, and deduce from the tor amplitude of E and its independence of base change that the tensor products K_{n+1} dual tensor E map isomorphically onto K_n dual tensor E on the truncations below n plus a (proof lines 9265-9280).
Apply the pushforward to obtain that the maps M_{n+1} to M_n are isomorphisms on the truncations below n plus a, and that the same holds after any base change (proof lines 9280-9282).

Form the cone C_n of that map, test it against the residue field of a point after base change to see that its cohomology is concentrated in degrees at least n plus a, and apply the lifting statement to conclude that C_n has tor amplitude in the interval from n plus a to some m_n; hence its dual has tor amplitude in the symmetric interval (proof lines 9283-9288).

Set L_n equal to the dual of M_n and conclude that the maps L_n to L_{n+1} are isomorphisms above minus n minus a, so the homotopy colimit L is pseudo-coherent, and then identify the two sides of the required equality with the base change compatibility already established (proof lines 9289-9329).
proof_roadmap: Approximate K by a homotopy colimit of perfect complexes (proof lines 9251-9254).
Build the inverse system of perfect complexes on the base and its base change compatibility (proof lines 9254-9264).
Degree bookkeeping: truncation isomorphisms, tor amplitude of E, and the cones C_n (proof lines 9265-9288).
Dualise, take the homotopy colimit to get the pseudo-coherent L, and read off the equality (proof lines 9289-9329).
difficulty_reason: 78 行、构造性很强：先把伪凝聚的 K 写成 perfect 复形的同伦余极限（截断逐段逼近），取对偶后与 E 张量、用「相对 perfect 的顺像仍是 perfect 且与基变换交换」得到基上的逆向系统 M_n；随后是一段**度数记账**（截断同构 + E 的 tor amplitude 与基变换无关 ⇒ 每个锥 C_n 的 tor amplitude 有下界，再取其对偶得上界），最后令 L_n = M_n 的对偶、认出 L = hocolim L_n 伪凝聚、并借已建立的基变换相容性读出题面的等式。承重演算（构造、度数、极限的伪凝聚性）都在 span 内；7 处引用（4 同章、3 跨章）作导航桩。判 H3。
